notes.title: Official Korean Language Patch
notes.content:
Dear Yumemi Dreamer fans,

Thank you for all the support throughout the years. To make more people able to experience this title in their native language, we are happy to announce that we have added official Korean language support! 

We hope this can improve the overall experience, and if you have any suggestions on this update, please feel free to share them with us.

Cheers,

notes.title: "Star Melody Yumemi Dreamer" Special Pack & Complete Pack now available
notes.content:
Dear Kugado Fans,

Thank you so much to all of you who've followed us this far each week!
We are pleased to announce that the Special Pack & Complete Pack of "Star Melody Yumemi Dreamer" are available today, April 7th, 2022.

[b]■Special Pack [/b] 
These are the special chapters of Kugado Studio's famed  "Kuroneko-san Team", their first completely new game in ten years!
[u][b]Please make sure to play through to chapter12 before purchasing.[/b][/u]
[list][*]Ayumu Chapter 10: Attack of the Moon Rose
[*]Ayumu Chapter 11: Birdcage of Darkness
[*]Ayumu Chapter 12: A Friend
[*]Suzune Chapter 10 The Two Traps
[*]Suzune Chapter 11: Suzune Rescue Operation
[*]Suzune Chapter 12 The Brilliance of Meteor
[*]Chapter SP Triangle Date[/list]

[b]■Complete Pack[/b]
This complete pack includes all single chapters and the additional character routes.

Chapter 1 and 2 are currently available as a free demo version, so if you are interested in the game, please take the opportunity to give it a try.

notes.title: Launch celebration Retweet Campaign!
notes.content:
Dear Kogado Fans

We are pleased to inform you that "Star Melody Yumemi Dreamer" has been officially released on Friday, January 21, 2022, and we would like to invite you to participate in a giveaway campaign!

The giveaway campaign will be hosted on the official Kogado Studio Twitter account from January 28, 2022 (Fri) to February 28, 2022 (Mon)! As long as you have a Twitter account, then no matter where you live, you can participate!

[h3]【Period】[b][u]January 28, 2022 (Fri) 12:00 - February 28, 2022 (Mon) 23:59[/u][/b][/h3]
[h3][Prizes and number of winners][/h3]
　We'll be giving away [b]1,000 yen worth of Amazon gift card[/b] to [b]5[/b] winners
　In addition, [b]100 people[/b] will receive [b]one Kogado original sticker[/b].
[u][b](*) The sticker will be randomly selected from the following three types: Yumemi Dreamer logo, Kuroneko-san Team logo, and Kogado Studio logo. [/b][/u].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41579866/221bafc5ab38c761b2095eeab15c4dc49d80abf9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41579866/3042d361d2fbadf8f94c700a42f5dd91b8142f5f.png[/img]
[h3][How to apply][/h3]
You can apply through the following methods.
[list]
[*] [b]If you participate via Twitter[/b].
[b]Follow [u]Kogado Studio Official Twitter[/u][/b]!
And
Retweet [b]the [b]official tweet[/b] of this campaign[/b]!
[*] If you participate via [b]Wechat[/b
[b]Follow [u]Kogado Studio Official Wechat[/u][/b]!
And
Share the [b]official article[/b] of this campaign[/b] for at least [b]3 days[/b], and
Send us a screenshot of it via [b]DM[/b]!

[h3][About the application and lottery][/h3]
[list]
[*] In principle, one account can only apply once.
[*] If you have canceled your retweet or didn't share Wechat for more than 3 days, you will not be eligible for the lottery.
[*] Locked accounts are not eligible for the lottery.
[*] Winners will be selected by a strict lottery after the application period ends.
[*] Entries will be void in the following cases.
(1) Entries made by employees of the Company or its affiliates, or by persons related to this campaign.
(2) In the event that the Company deems the entry to be an automatic entry by a program, etc.
(3) In the event that the Company deems the entry to be fraudulent in any other way.
[/list]

[h3][About the announcement of winners][/h3]
[list]
[*] Winners will be contacted individually via [b]DM[/b] from the "Kogado Studio [Official] Account" after the entry deadline.
[*] Please be aware that the prizes cannot be selected. 
[*] Prizes will be shipped around [b]mid-March 2022[/b].
Amazon gift card winners will receive their prizes by [b]email type Amazon gift certificate[/b], and our original sticker winners will receive their prizes by [b]mail[/b].
Please note that if we are unable to deliver the prize due to a mistake in your email address or home address, or if you wan not able to receive the prize, you will be deemed to have [b]abandoned[/b] the receipt of the prize and your winnings will be [b]invalid[/b].
In the case of [*]international shipping, stickers will be shipped by [b]airmail (air letter)[/b] (or included with Omni Shop shipping).
Please note that delivery may be delayed due to infectious disease countermeasures or other reasons.
[*] We will not be able to make individual inquiries regarding the results (confirmation of winning or losing).
[*] Please note that if we are unable to send [b]DM[/b] for any reason, the prize will be [b]invalid[/b].
[*] The right to win is limited to the winner and cannot be transferred to another person or exchanged for cash.
[/list]

notes.title: "Star Melody Yumemi Dreamer" now available on Steam
notes.content:
Dear Kogado fans,

We would like to thank you for your patience!

This is the first completely new title from Kugado Studio's famous "Kuroneko-san Team" in 10 years!
The free trial version of [b]Star Melody Yumemi Dreamer[/b] will be available on Steam today, January 21, 2022.

The first two episodes of the free trial version are both over an hour-long in auto-play mode!
The third episode and onwards will be released every week on Thursday, so don't miss out!

Save the world in this Magical Girl rhythm adventure! Your bond becomes their strength.
Let's open the door to the Dreamworld together!

※The free trial version supports Japanese, English, and Chinese (Simplified and Traditional).
